title: A trip — irregular past
vocabFocus: ir/ser, hacer, tener, estar in the past
listenFocus: Friends comparing what they each did
practiceFocus: Retell a group outing, contrasting yo with ellos

points.title: Day 13’s chunks, now with every person
points.rule: Fui, hice, tuve, and estuve were single fixed chunks in week two. These four verbs are irregular in every person, and they do not use the endings from day 22. Ir and ser share the same preterite forms. Context tells them apart.

grammar.notYet: Dar, ver, and decir in the preterite. Vi, from day 13, stays a chunk for now.

phrases.spanish: Fui a la playa con mis amigos.
phrases.english: I went to the beach with my friends.

phrases.note: Ser, not ir, but the same word.

phrases.english: It was very hot that day.

phrases.spanish: Hicimos una excursión a la montaña.
phrases.english: We went on a hike in the mountains.

phrases.spanish: Tuvo un problema con el vuelo.
phrases.english: He or she had a problem with the flight.
We had to wait two hours.
phrases.note: Tuvimos que is the past of tener que.

phrases.spanish: Estuvieron en el hotel toda la tarde.
phrases.english: They were at the hotel all afternoon.
I was sick on the second day.
They went to Barcelona by train.
What did you do on the last day?

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.english: What did you all do on Saturday?

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: Fuimos a la playa. Hizo mucho sol.
lines.english: We went to the beach. It was very sunny.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.spanish: Nosotros tuvimos un problema. Estuvimos en el aeropuerto cuatro horas.
lines.english: We had a problem. We were at the airport for four hours.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.english: That is awful. Did you make it to the hotel in the end?

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.spanish: Sí, llegamos tarde, pero estuvo bien. Hicimos una cena tranquila.
lines.english: Yes, we arrived late, but it turned out fine. We had a quiet dinner.

practice.title: You, and the group
practice.instruction: Retell a group outing. Say three things you did with fui, hice, tuve, or estuve. Then say three things the group did with fueron, hicieron, tuvieron, or estuvieron.
starters: Mis amigos fueron… Hicieron… Tuvieron… Estuvieron…
tips: These four verbs do not follow day 22’s pattern at all.
That is why they stayed chunks for two weeks before their full chart appeared.
